protocol.sampling: Whole UTC hour closes only; fixed before fetching earlier outcomes
protocol.model: Market-offset logistic correction, L2 .1 and coefficient bounds +/-.25 unchanged
protocol.execution: Recompute inputs at execution quote; 1% bankroll risk, .04 edge, .02 slippage, .07 fee
protocol.stress: Delay only new flow/basis inputs 60 seconds; retain current executable quote
protocol.inference: Exploratory rolling development, July dates reused; no promotion or holdout release
protocol.fee_caveat: June fee coefficient .07 is assumed, not verified historical overrides
